name: Shark's Song
source:
Hilda, a sentient bipedal shark, lives with her creator at the bottom of the sea and tries to avoid public attention... but is this what she really wants?

[From [url=https://omure.itch.io/sharks-song]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
希尔达是一条有知觉的双足鲨鱼，与她的创造者一起生活在海底，并试图避免公众的关注……但这真的是她想要的吗？

[来自[url=https://omure.itch.io/sharks-song]itch.io[/url]]
